value.rationale: A symbol of modulus exactly one generates an infinite-rank operator in every Schatten class. The precise complex asymptotic, root-exponential constant and degree-dependent counting coefficient quantify oscillatory cancellation in weighted Bergman spaces, far beyond a qualitative compactness criterion; this is a natural spectral model, not an arbitrary finite computation.
